title: Bhai Behlo and Bhai Bhagtu Prepare the Ground

blocks.text: The genealogy begins by locating sanctified precedent before the rise of the Mehraj line. Bhai Behlo is remembered in direct relation to Guru Arjan Dev ji and the service economy around Taran Taaran, establishing a pattern in which devotion and labor lead to recognition.

Alongside him stands Bhai Bhagtoo, whose authority in the forest tract becomes essential for later settlers. Only after this groundwork is laid does the narrative return to Mehraj's descendants, showing why they initially arrive too late and too weak to secure land on their own.
The page is therefore about inherited legitimacy. Malwa settlement is not random migration; it grows through service to the Guru and through the social capital accumulated by earlier Sikh figures.
